content_html:
Someone to talk to, any time

Free · In-App Purchases · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Warm chats, favorite music, classic movies, and photo memories, just by asking Nara. Simple voice control so everyone stays connected and no one gets left behind Callnara was designed with older people in mind, and with the families and friends who love them. It is built for everyone, so no one is left behind.. Whatever your age, Nara is here for you. Life gets busy. Family and friends live full lives, people move away, and sometimes the days can feel a little quiet. We built Callnara to help bring people closer together, and so nobody has to feel alone in those quiet moments. Meet Nara. She is warm, patient and kind, and always happy to hear from you, day or night. SIMPLE FOR EVERYONE You don't need to type anything. Open the app, tap once, and start talking, just like you would with a friend. Nara never rushes you, and she is always patient. SOMEONE TO TALK TO Nara calls you by your name, asks how you are, and listens to whatever is on your mind. Tell her about your day, share an old story, or simply enjoy a bit of company. SHARE YOUR MEMORIES TOGETHER You or your family can add photos to Callnara, each with a caption. The grandkids at the beach, a wedding day, the old family home, a holiday from years ago. Nara reads the caption out to you and, if you like, talks about the photo with you. We don't always remember every face or every moment, so it's lovely to have Nara there to help bring those memories back. When you're ready, just say "next photo" and she'll show you the next one. Look through them on your own, or sit down together with family and friends and share the stories. WATCH AND LISTEN TOGETHER Just ask. "Play some Frank Sinatra." "Put on an old western." "I'd love to hear some hymns." Nara will find something from her library of classics. Enjoy it on your own, or make it an afternoon with the people you love. READINGS FROM THE BIBLE Nara can read the Bible to you. Ask for your favourite verse or passage, or simply ask for something on a theme like hope, comfort or peace, and she will read it aloud for you. A COMPANION, NOT A REPLACEMENT Nara is not here to replace family, friends or carers. Nothing ever could. She is here for the quiet hours in between, and to give the people you love one more way to stay close. YOUR LANGUAGE Nara speaks several languages. Choose yours and talk the way you always have. LOOKING OUT FOR YOU If you have nominated a family member, friend or carer, and Nara senses you may be upset or in distress, she can let them know. That way, the people who care about you can be there for you too. Callnara is not an emergency service and does not replace professional care. In an emergency, always call your local emergency number. EASY FROM THE START Sign in once with your Apple ID. No passwords to remember, nothing complicated to set up. Callnara. Bringing people closer, one conversation at a time. View our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use here: Privacy Policy: https://callnara.com/privacy Terms of Use: https://callnara.com/terms
